title: Fix Impeller's colour-filter-plus-blend fault by moving each blend onto its own layer
context: On Impeller (Flutter 3.47.5), a drawImage whose Paint carries both a colorFilter and a non-default blendMode composites as srcOver. This made the Meadow's night mountains white and shifted the mountains, lake and waterfalls off-colour. Probed with a 16x16 engine test and the Meadow layers on both engines.
options: Keep Skia on macOS and Android (owner ruled out)
Pre-bake filtered masks and blend them without a filter
Blend on a saveLayer and draw the image inside with the filter only; clip the dstIn mask layer to its rect
outcome: Chosen: blend on a saveLayer, filter on the image. The mask's dstIn layer is clipped with clipRect(rect), because on Skia restoring a dstIn layer clears everything outside the layer; without the clip the unclipped version wiped the night overlay from the whole meadow. This leaves Skia's layer images byte-identical, gives mountains a median of 1 and lake/falls within a few levels of Skia on Impeller, and changes page goldens only on the mountain band's edges. Shipped in PR #245 (Step meadow-impeller-compositing).
